title: Food bought on the card: a budget line counts its spends on every account and is reserved once from the card's paying account; a refund given back to its line (final_review_1 finding 4, decision O4, the refund watch item)
story: Mako's shape, twice. Set up Fri 11 Dec 2026, the day after pay. Bank 1 (the main bank) and bank 2 hold 400,000 each; pay of 300,000 lands in each on the 10th (moved earlier), bank 1's pay starts the period. Card 1 is paid from bank 1, card 2 from bank 2; both close on the 15th and are paid in full on the 10th of the next month (moved later). Food is 50,000 a month and names no account, so it is on the main bank; a second food line of 50,000 is set on card 2. Free to spend is 60,000 a month and names no account. At setup bank 1's split holds 50,000 for Food and 40,000 in Free to spend; bank 2's holds 50,000 for the card 2 food line. Sat 12 Dec: 30,000 of food on each card. Mon 14 Dec: a 5,000 refund on each card; on card 1 the person gives it back to Food, on card 2 they do not. Every amount is made up.

refund; the person names no line

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 400,000 (b1 today) - 20,000 (Food left: 50,000 less the 30,000 bought on card 1, counted on every account [O4]; the 30,000 itself comes off with card 1's payment on 11 Jan, after pay on 8 Jan; Free to spend is not taken off the headroom, it caps the headline [B1]) - 0 (minimum) = 380,000

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 400,000 (b2 today) - 20,000 (Food on card 2 left, reserved from b2, which pays card 2 [O4]; the 30,000 already bought comes off with card 2's payment on 11 Jan, after pay on 8 Jan) - 0 (minimum) = 380,000

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 40,000 (Free to spend left, on b1, the main bank [O4]; it caps the headroom of 380,000 + 380,000) = 40,000

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 400,000 (b1 today) - 25,000 (Food left: 50,000 - 30,000 + 5,000, the refund the person gave back to Food) - 0 (minimum) = 375,000

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 400,000 (b2 today) - 20,000 (Food on card 2 left; the refund names no line, so it lowers what card 2 owes and gives nothing back to the line) - 0 (minimum) = 380,000

asks.question: card_due
asks.why: 30,000 (food 12 Dec) - 5,000 (refund 14 Dec; the statement closes Tue 15 Dec, paid Sun 10 Jan moved to Mon 11 Jan) = 25,000
